get.description: Retrieves a chat with thread details from LiveChat.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: The ID of the chat to fetch.

schema.description: The ID of the chat to fetch.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: The thread ID to fetch. Defaults to the latest thread if omitted.

schema.description: The thread ID to fetch. Defaults to the latest thread if omitted.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

groupIds.description: Group IDs that can access the chat.

isFollowed.description: Whether the chat is followed by the requester.

groupIds.description: Group IDs that can access the thread.

createdAt.description: Time when the thread was created.

customerVisit.description: Customer visit details associated with the thread.

createdAt.description: Time when the event was created.

deleted.description: Whether the event represents a deleted event.

queue.description: Queue details for the thread, when queued.

queuedAt.description: Time when the thread entered the queue.

restrictedAccess.description: Reason why thread access is restricted, when present.

summary.description: AI-generated summary of the thread, when available.

updatedAt.description: Time when the summary was updated.

userIds.description: Identifiers of users in the thread.

agentLastEventCreatedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest agent event for the user.

createdAt.description: Time when the user identity was created.

customerLastEventCreatedAt.description: Timestamp of the latest customer event for the user.

eventsSeenUpTo.description: Latest event timestamp seen by the user.

present.description: Whether the user is currently present in the chat.

chatsCount.description: Number of chats for the user.

greetingsAcceptedCount.description: Number of greetings accepted by the user.

greetingsShownCount.description: Number of greetings shown to the user.

pageViewsCount.description: Number of page views for the user.

threadsCount.description: Number of threads for the user.

ticketsCount.description: Number of tickets related to the user.

visitsCount.description: Number of visits for the user.

createdAt.description: Time when the ticket was created.

visit.description: Most recent visit details for a customer user.

openedAt.description: Time when the page was opened.

lastPages.description: Most recent pages visited by the user.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
